exports.note: The state of 18 October, continued by three passes from 2026-10-25 to 28 on the released 0.15.0: countries and positions (the UN M49 standard's 248 countries and areas as places, every place with a point from Natural Earth's map units, and 629 of the 1,122 Events, the places' own lives aside, placed in a country), laws (21 laws that set the model's numbers against each other, with a fresh agent's ledger of what they found), and their corrections, by script and by a fresh agent from sources. 543 processes, 1,400 Events and 21 laws; the coverage report finds the work complete. The state of 18 October is at commit 41d0702 (fileSha256 8a52e83bffb1e084…, headGraphHash b42a853dd74020f4…), and the state of 15 October at commit 0220fb3 (fileSha256 301304175bad6fb9…, headGraphHash 74c743aca0dfd4a4…). As there, graph hashes from revision 1 on differ from copies made before 2026-10-14, when the graph history was rebuilt.

notPublished.construction: The structure (run 2, revision 5) and its long-term fill, with every recorded verdict.
notPublished.why: Its notes link files by absolute local paths, which are part of its hash-bound history. It stays out of this repository until a version without them can be exported; structure/ holds the tree it built.
